metadata.title: 七上四类原创练习题库
metadata.coverageZh: 四类各128题、共512题。每类4个能力标签，每个32题。阅读为32篇原创短文，每篇4题；完形为128篇独立迷你短文，每篇1空。
limitationsZh: 题库有限，语境、阅读、完形做完后不重复出旧题；句子讲解可明确重练。
阅读同一篇的4道不同考点题连续完成后再换新文章，同篇不在新组重复。
旧版已经完成的阅读材料仍保持已完成，不为凑数重出；保留旧答题记录。
句子讲解为客观选择题判分，不判断自由口头或书面解释。
正确率仅反映本题库表现，不能作为标准化评级。
题目经过程序检查与编辑复核，尚未经独立教师实测。
metadata.contentBasis: 保留原主库96题，以及语境和完形各24道既有原创补充题；新增368题。全部例句、短文及解析为原创，无复制第三方试卷。

concepts.label: 固定搭配中的介词
concepts.tipZh: 先认出完整搭配，再根据宾语确定介词。

concepts.label: 根据语境辨别动作
concepts.tipZh: 找到宾语和上下文提示，选择意思和搭配都合适的动作。

concepts.label: 学科词义与学习内容
concepts.tipZh: 根据正在学的内容判断学科，不只看某个熟悉单词。

concepts.label: 空间关系短语
concepts.tipZh: 先明确两个物体的实际位置，再选择空间关系。

concepts.label: 定位明确细节
concepts.tipZh: 根据题干找到原文对应句，不把其他人物或物品的信息混在一起。

concepts.label: 理解时间与先后
concepts.tipZh: 看清时间词和活动的对应关系，必要时做简单时间计算。

concepts.label: 判断代词指代
concepts.tipZh: 联系前后句，判断代词所指的人、物或群体。

concepts.label: 理解人物行动目的
concepts.tipZh: 找到 because、to 或上下文中的原因，不能只凭常识猜测。

concepts.label: 主语与 be 动词一致
concepts.tipZh: 先找主语，再判断单复数，选择 am、is 或 are。

concepts.label: 上下文逻辑关系
concepts.tipZh: 区分原因、结果、转折和选择；读完整的前后分句。

concepts.label: 时间介词
concepts.tipZh: 具体时刻用 at；星期或具体日期用 on；月份用 in。

concepts.label: 短文中的名词选择
concepts.tipZh: 用上下文提供的功能或动作线索判断物品或地点。

concepts.label: 识别句子主语
concepts.tipZh: 先问“谁做这个动作”，找出主语。

concepts.label: 识别谓语动词
concepts.tipZh: 找表示主语动作的动词；不要把时间词当动词。

concepts.label: 识别动作宾语
concepts.tipZh: 问“做这个动作涉及什么或谁”，找动词后的宾语。

concepts.label: 识别时间状语
concepts.tipZh: 找出表示“什么时候”的完整部分，区别于地点信息。

questions.prompt: Mia is good ___ chess. She often wins.
questions.explanationZh: be good at 表示“擅长”，后面接擅长的活动。

distractorExplanations.in: good in 不是这里表示“擅长下棋”的目标搭配。
distractorExplanations.on: on 不能组成 be good at 这一搭配。
distractorExplanations.to: be good to 表示“对……好”，不是“擅长”。

questions.prompt: Ben is interested ___ wildlife. He reads about insects.
questions.explanationZh: be interested in 表示“对……感兴趣”，这里谈的是野生动物。

distractorExplanations.on: interested 后表示兴趣对象用 in，不用 on。
distractorExplanations.at: at 常出现在 good at 中，不能搬到 interested 后。
distractorExplanations.for: for 表示目的等，不能构成 be interested in。

questions.prompt: Can you help me ___ my geography homework?
questions.explanationZh: help somebody with something 表示“帮助某人做某事”。

distractorExplanations.from: from 表示来源，不连接 help 与所帮助的事情。
distractorExplanations.at: at 不是 help somebody with something 的介词。
distractorExplanations.of: of 表示所属等，这里需用 with 引出作业。

questions.prompt: Please listen ___ the teacher before you start.
questions.explanationZh: listen to somebody 表示“听某人讲话”。

distractorExplanations.of: of 不用来连接 listen 与所听的人。
distractorExplanations.at: listen 连接所听的人或内容时用 to。
distractorExplanations.in: in 不用来引出 listen 的对象。

questions.prompt: Our new classroom is different ___ the old one.
questions.explanationZh: different from 表示“与……不同”。

distractorExplanations.of: of 不能构成这里“与……不同”的搭配。
distractorExplanations.with: with 不能替代 different from 中的 from。
distractorExplanations.by: by 不能构成这里的比较搭配。

questions.prompt: 哪个短语表示“为聚会准备食物”？
questions.explanationZh: prepare something for... 表示“为……准备某物”；for 引出准备的目的。

distractorExplanations.prepare food from the party: from 表示来源，不能表达“为聚会”。
distractorExplanations.prepare food under the party: under 表示在……下面，不能表达此处的用途。
distractorExplanations.prepare food between the party: between 表示在两者或多者之间；此短语也缺少合适的对象。

questions.prompt: We have a camera. Let’s ___ photos of the village.
questions.explanationZh: 相机用于拍照，take photos 是“拍照”。

distractorExplanations.brush: brush 表示刷，不能表示用相机拍照。
distractorExplanations.spell: spell 表示拼写，不能和 photos 构成“拍照”。
distractorExplanations.raise: raise 表示举起或提高，不表示拍照。

questions.prompt: Before breakfast, I ___ my teeth.
questions.explanationZh: brush my teeth 是“刷牙”，符合早餐前的日常活动。

distractorExplanations.count: count 是数数，句中不是在数牙齿。
distractorExplanations.paint: paint 是涂色或画画，不是日常清洁牙齿。
distractorExplanations.collect: collect 是收集，不能表达刷牙。

questions.prompt: The birthday candles are burning. Make a wish, then ___ them out.
questions.explanationZh: blow out 表示“吹灭”，与正在燃烧的生日蜡烛相配。

distractorExplanations.grow: grow 表示生长，不组成“吹灭”。
distractorExplanations.join: join 表示加入，不能表示熄灭蜡烛。
distractorExplanations.listen: listen 表示听，不能与 out 构成这里所需的意思。

questions.prompt: The music club needs new members. I want to ___ it.
questions.explanationZh: join a club 表示“加入俱乐部”。

distractorExplanations.spell: spell 是拼写，不表示成为成员。
distractorExplanations.raise: raise 是举起、提升等，不表示加入。
distractorExplanations.brush: brush 是刷，不表示参加俱乐部。

questions.prompt: I cannot open the door without my key. I ___ to find it.
questions.explanationZh: need to do 表示“需要做”，钥匙丢失使找到它成为必要。

distractorExplanations.paint: paint 表示画画，不能表达这里的需要。
distractorExplanations.celebrate: celebrate 表示庆祝，不能表达找钥匙的必要性。
distractorExplanations.climb: climb 表示攀爬，不构成这里的意思。

questions.prompt: There are many names on the list. Please ___ your own name with a pen.
questions.explanationZh: circle 在这里是动词“圈出”，用笔圈出自己的名字。

distractorExplanations.hike: hike 是徒步，不是对名单上的名字做标记。
distractorExplanations.rise: rise 是上升，不能以 your name 作这种动作的宾语。
distractorExplanations.laugh: laugh 是笑，不能表达圈名字。

questions.prompt: We learn about plants and animals in ___.
questions.explanationZh: 植物和动物是生物学的学习内容。

distractorExplanations.history: history 是历史，主要学习过去的人与事件。
distractorExplanations.IT: IT 是信息技术；这里没有电脑或技术的提示。
distractorExplanations.French: French 是法语；这里的重点是植物和动物。

questions.prompt: We use maps to learn about countries in ___.
questions.explanationZh: 地图和国家指向 geography（地理）。

distractorExplanations.music: music 是音乐，不以地图和国家为题中重点。
distractorExplanations.PE: PE 是体育，与这里的地图学习不符。
distractorExplanations.art: art 是美术，题目在学习国家而非绘画。

questions.prompt: We learn about life hundreds of years ago in ___.
questions.explanationZh: hundreds of years ago 指数百年前，符合历史课。

distractorExplanations.IT: IT 学信息技术，不是题中所说的过去生活。
distractorExplanations.PE: PE 是体育课，不是研究数百年前的生活。
distractorExplanations.music: music 是音乐；题中没有音乐学习的提示。

questions.prompt: Today we learn to write a simple computer program in ___.
questions.explanationZh: computer program（计算机程序）指向信息技术课。

distractorExplanations.PE: PE 是体育，不是学习写程序。
distractorExplanations.geography: geography 是地理，题目重点是计算机程序。
distractorExplanations.music: music 是音乐，题中没有作曲或乐器。

questions.prompt: Our teacher says “Bonjour” and teaches us to speak ___.
questions.explanationZh: Bonjour 是法语问候语，且 speak 后需要这里所学的语言。

distractorExplanations.biology: biology 是学科，不是此处能 speak 的语言。
distractorExplanations.history: history 是历史，不是语言名称。
distractorExplanations.PE: PE 是体育，不是语言名称。

questions.prompt: We practise with a violin and drums in ___ class.
questions.explanationZh: 小提琴和鼓都是乐器，符合音乐课的练习。

distractorExplanations.geography: 地理课的核心内容不是演奏乐器。
distractorExplanations.IT: 信息技术课的核心内容不是演奏乐器。
distractorExplanations.history: 这里是实际练习乐器，未涉及历史研究。

questions.prompt: 图书馆和体育馆隔街相对。The library is ___ the gym.
questions.explanationZh: across from 表示“在……对面”，隔街相对符合这一关系。

distractorExplanations.inside: inside 表示在内部，不是隔街相对。
distractorExplanations.under: under 表示在下面，不是对面。
distractorExplanations.on: on 表示在上面，不是隔街相对。

questions.prompt: 我的座位紧挨着窗户。My seat is ___ the window.
questions.explanationZh: next to 表示“紧挨着”。

distractorExplanations.far from: far from 表示离……远，与紧挨着相反。
distractorExplanations.above: above 表示在上方，不表示紧挨着。
distractorExplanations.opposite: opposite 表示在对面，不表示紧挨着。

questions.prompt: 旗杆位于操场正中央。The flagpole is ___ the sports field.
questions.explanationZh: in the middle of 表示“在……中间”。

distractorExplanations.outside: outside 表示在外面，与正中央相反。
distractorExplanations.above: above 表示在上方，不表示场地中央。
distractorExplanations.behind: behind 表示在后面，不表示中央。

questions.prompt: 老师面向同学，站在全班前面。The teacher is ___ the class.
questions.explanationZh: in front of 表示“在……前面”。

distractorExplanations.under: under 表示在下面，与老师站在全班前面的意思不符。
distractorExplanations.inside: inside 表示在内部，不表达此处的前后关系。
distractorExplanations.on: on 表示在上面，不表示站在同学前面。

questions.prompt: 书包在书桌下面。The schoolbag is ___ the desk.
questions.explanationZh: under 表示“在……下面”。

distractorExplanations.above: above 是在上方，与下面相反。
distractorExplanations.inside: inside 是在内部，不是桌子下面。
distractorExplanations.on: on 是在上面，与下面不符。

questions.prompt: 储物柜在教室最后面。The lockers are ___ the classroom.
questions.explanationZh: at the back of 表示“在……后部”。

distractorExplanations.above: above 是在上方，不是教室后部。
distractorExplanations.outside: outside 是在外面，不是教室里面的后部。
distractorExplanations.under: under 是在下面，不表示后部。

questions.title: 照顾新成员
questions.prompt: The younger club members often need help. Our helper is patient and good ____ children, so they enjoy working with her.
questions.evidenceQuote: patient and good ____ children
questions.explanationZh: 这里说的是善于与孩子相处，be good with children；good at 后接擅长的活动或领域。

distractorExplanations.at: at 表示擅长某种活动；children 是交往对象，此处用 with。
distractorExplanations.on: on 不能构成表示善于和孩子相处的搭配。
distractorExplanations.from: from 表示来源，不能接在 good 后表达相处能力。

questions.spokenFullText: The younger club members often need help. Our helper is patient and good with children, so they enjoy working with her.
questions.contentFingerprint: content-v1:the younger club members often need help. our helper is patient and good ____ children, so they enjoy working with her.

questions.title: 相似的午餐盒
questions.prompt: These two lunch boxes have the same shape and almost the same colour. My box is similar ____ yours, but mine has a star on it.
questions.evidenceQuote: the same shape and almost the same colour
questions.explanationZh: 形状和颜色几乎相同，表示“与……相似”，固定搭配是 similar to。

distractorExplanations.from: from 常用于 different from；这里强调相似而非不同。
distractorExplanations.under: under 表示在下方，不表达两者相似。
distractorExplanations.for: for 不能组成此处 similar to 的比较关系。

questions.spokenFullText: These two lunch boxes have the same shape and almost the same colour. My box is similar to yours, but mine has a star on it.
questions.contentFingerprint: content-v1:these two lunch boxes have the same shape and almost the same colour. my box is similar ____ yours, but mine has a star on it.

questions.title: 查看路线
questions.prompt: The route to the new sports field is on the whiteboard. Before leaving, look ____ the drawing so you know which way to go.
questions.evidenceQuote: The route to the new sports field
questions.explanationZh: look at 表示“看”，这里要看白板上的路线图；look 后接所看的对象时用 at。

distractorExplanations.of: of 不能引出 look 所看的对象。
distractorExplanations.from: look from 可涉及观看位置，但这里 drawing 是要看的对象，不是观察点。
distractorExplanations.with: with 表示伴随或工具，不能组成“看这幅图”。

questions.spokenFullText: The route to the new sports field is on the whiteboard. Before leaving, look at the drawing so you know which way to go.
questions.contentFingerprint: content-v1:the route to the new sports field is on the whiteboard. before leaving, look ____ the drawing so you know which way to go.

questions.title: 利用纸张空白面
questions.prompt: Only one side of this paper has writing on it. Let us make use ____ the clean side for our spelling practice.
questions.evidenceQuote: Only one side of this paper has writing on it.
questions.explanationZh: make use of 表示“利用”；纸的另一面没有字，可以利用它练习拼写。

distractorExplanations.to: to 不能代替 make use of 中固定的 of。
distractorExplanations.at: at 不能构成表示“利用”的目标搭配。
distractorExplanations.from: from 表示来源，不组成 make use of。

questions.spokenFullText: Only one side of this paper has writing on it. Let us make use of the clean side for our spelling practice.
questions.contentFingerprint: content-v1:only one side of this paper has writing on it. let us make use ____ the clean side for our spelling practice.

questions.title: 爱上戏剧
questions.prompt: I did not know much about drama before the school show. After acting in it, I fell in love ____ drama and wanted to act again.
questions.evidenceQuote: wanted to act again
questions.explanationZh: fall in love with 表示“爱上”；演出后还想再次表演，说明爱上了戏剧。

distractorExplanations.at: at 不能接在 fell in love 后表达爱上某事。
distractorExplanations.from: from 表示来源，不能组成 fall in love with。
distractorExplanations.on: on 不是 fall in love with 的介词。

questions.spokenFullText: I did not know much about drama before the school show. After acting in it, I fell in love with drama and wanted to act again.
questions.contentFingerprint: content-v1:i did not know much about drama before the school show. after acting in it, i fell in love ____ drama and wanted to act again.

questions.title: 花时间完成模型
questions.prompt: The model is difficult to make. I spend an hour ____ it every afternoon until all the parts are ready.
questions.evidenceQuote: spend an hour ____ it
questions.explanationZh: spend time on something 表示“在某事上花时间”；it 指制作中的模型。

distractorExplanations.from: from 表示来源，不能连接 spend time 与所花时间的事情。
distractorExplanations.of: of 表示所属等，不是 spend time on 的搭配。
distractorExplanations.under: under 表示在下方，不能表达在模型上花时间。

questions.spokenFullText: The model is difficult to make. I spend an hour on it every afternoon until all the parts are ready.
questions.contentFingerprint: content-v1:the model is difficult to make. i spend an hour ____ it every afternoon until all the parts are ready.

questions.title: 升旗动作
questions.prompt: The flag is still at the bottom of the pole. Two students pull the rope to ____ it to the top before the school meeting.
questions.evidenceQuote: pull the rope
questions.explanationZh: 绳子把旗从杆底拉到顶端，对应 raise（举起、升起）；此处 raise 后直接接 it。

distractorExplanations.collect: collect 是收集，不能表达把一面旗升到杆顶。
distractorExplanations.paint: paint 是绘画或涂色，文中拉绳不是在上色。
distractorExplanations.choose: choose 是选择，文中已经确定了要升的旗。

questions.spokenFullText: The flag is still at the bottom of the pole. Two students pull the rope to raise it to the top before the school meeting.
questions.contentFingerprint: content-v1:the flag is still at the bottom of the pole. two students pull the rope to ____ it to the top before the school meeting.

questions.title: 收集落叶
questions.prompt: Our class will compare leaf shapes tomorrow. We ____ fallen leaves of different kinds and put them in a box for the lesson.
questions.evidenceQuote: put them in a box for the lesson
questions.explanationZh: 把不同种类的落叶放到盒里供比较，是 collect（收集）；不是随意吹动或拼写。

distractorExplanations.blow: blow 表示吹，不能表达把不同叶子归到盒里的收集过程。
distractorExplanations.greet: greet 表示向人问好，不适用于收集落叶。
distractorExplanations.spell: spell 表示拼写，不能以 fallen leaves 表达收集。

questions.spokenFullText: Our class will compare leaf shapes tomorrow. We collect fallen leaves of different kinds and put them in a box for the lesson.
questions.contentFingerprint: content-v1:our class will compare leaf shapes tomorrow. we ____ fallen leaves of different kinds and put them in a box for the lesson.

questions.title: 迎接来访者
questions.prompt: When visitors arrive at our classroom, we smile and ____ them by saying, “Welcome to our school!”
questions.evidenceQuote: by saying, “Welcome to our school!”
questions.explanationZh: 微笑并说欢迎的话是在 greet（向……问好、迎接）来访者。

distractorExplanations.count: count 是数数，不表达说欢迎语的行为。
distractorExplanations.climb: climb 是攀爬，不能表示向来访者问好。
distractorExplanations.grow: grow 是生长或种植，不是欢迎别人。

questions.spokenFullText: When visitors arrive at our classroom, we smile and greet them by saying, “Welcome to our school!”
questions.contentFingerprint: content-v1:when visitors arrive at our classroom, we smile and ____ them by saying, "welcome to our school!"

questions.title: 选择一项活动
questions.prompt: The two clubs meet at the same time, so I cannot attend both. I must ____ one: drama or hockey.
questions.evidenceQuote: I cannot attend both
questions.explanationZh: 两个社团时间冲突，无法都参加，因此必须 choose（选择）其中一个。

distractorExplanations.prepare: prepare 是准备，不能表达在两个互斥选项中作决定。
distractorExplanations.raise: raise 是举起或提高，不能表示选择社团。
distractorExplanations.brush: brush 是刷，不能表达选择活动。

questions.spokenFullText: The two clubs meet at the same time, so I cannot attend both. I must choose one: drama or hockey.
questions.contentFingerprint: content-v1:the two clubs meet at the same time, so i cannot attend both. i must ____ one: drama or hockey.

questions.title: 种植蔬菜
questions.prompt: We put carrot seeds in the soil and water them every day. We hope to ____ our own vegetables in the school yard.
questions.evidenceQuote: put carrot seeds in the soil and water them
questions.explanationZh: 播种并浇水是为了 grow vegetables（种植蔬菜）。

distractorExplanations.greet: greet 表示问好，不表示培育蔬菜。
distractorExplanations.spell: spell 表示拼写，播种浇水不是拼写活动。
distractorExplanations.send: send 是发送或送出，文中蔬菜尚在种植过程中。

questions.spokenFullText: We put carrot seeds in the soil and water them every day. We hope to grow our own vegetables in the school yard.
questions.contentFingerprint: content-v1:we put carrot seeds in the soil and water them every day. we hope to ____ our own vegetables in the school yard.

questions.title: 发送活动表
questions.prompt: Our classmates need the new activity list, but they are at home. I will ____ it to them by email tonight.
questions.evidenceQuote: to them by email tonight
questions.explanationZh: by email 表示通过电子邮件，把活动表发给同学要用 send。

distractorExplanations.climb: climb 是攀爬，不表示传送活动表。
distractorExplanations.rise: rise 是上升，通常不以 it 作这种动作的宾语。
distractorExplanations.brush: brush 是刷，不表示通过邮件发送。

questions.spokenFullText: Our classmates need the new activity list, but they are at home. I will send it to them by email tonight.
questions.contentFingerprint: content-v1:our classmates need the new activity list, but they are at home. i will ____ it to them by email tonight.

questions.title: 计算班级预算
